# La vache enragée

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** La vache enragée
- **Artist / Maker:** Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec French, 1864-1901
- **Date:** 1896
- **Style / Period:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** lithograph
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 13591
